1.title: Witnesses of ICE Killing in Houston Dispute the Official Account
1.summary: The agency said a Mexican immigrant driving a van tried to ram agents before they shot him dead. A lawyer for three passengers said that was untrue.

2.title: Trump Is Promoting ‘Freedom Fuel’ for $3.47 a Gallon. Who’s Behind It?
2.summary: The president has praised a network of 25 recently rebranded gas stations in the Philadelphia region that have been selling gas for considerably less than the national average.

3.title: Ghanaian Influencer Is Extradited Over Romance Scam Targeting Older Americans
3.summary: Prosecutors accused Frederick Kumi of running a scheme that defrauded Americans out of $8 million. He was flown to the United States on Thursday, his lawyer said.

4.title: Chip giant SK Hynix raises $26.5bn as shares surge in bumper US listing
4.summary: The shares are set to start trading on the Nasdaq on Friday in what will be the largest ever debut by a foreign firm.

5.title: Man nearly sucked out of window mid-air on Ryanair plane, passengers say
5.summary: The man's wife held onto his legs for around five minutes to stop him from being sucked out, officials say.

6.title: Zulu king expresses regret after video captures tirade against his wife
6.summary: In the footage widely shared in South Africa, King Misuzulu threatens to physically assault his wife and accuses her of cheating.
